title: RecruitmentEmailRecord
description: Structured record extracted from one recruitment/HR email. Frozen v1 (2026-10-21). Field order below is the canonical serialization order. Labeling semantics live in data/labeling_rules.md.

email_type.description: What this email is (its primary purpose).

company.description: Hiring company (the employer), not the ATS or job board.

job_title.description: Role title as written, without contract type, gender markers or reference codes.

work_mode.description: Work arrangement of the job, NOT the interview format.

stage.description: Where the candidacy stands after this email.

action_required.description: True if the email asks the candidate to do something.

deadline.description: Due date of the requested action (YYYY-MM-DD), resolved against the email's Date header. Not the interview date.

next_step.description: Short English summary of the next concrete step, or null.
